title: From Textual Information Sources to Linked Data in the Agatha Project
answer_short: The obtained results support our claim that the proposed system can be used as a base tool for information extraction for the Portuguese language.
answer_rationale: The effectiveness of the pipeline approach is evaluated by its ability to serve as a base tool for information extraction in Portuguese, as stated in the conclusions section. The system's modular design and integration of NLP modules allow it to process texts and populate an ontology, which is validated by its performance compared to existing systems and its application in real-world scenarios like criminal investigations.
